race.comment: ALDEBARAN ADA (7) has been tackling the top fillies and producing some good results, racing parked but sticking on well for second in the Need For Speed Princess two back before a solid fifth in the Victoria Trotters Oaks. Draws wide but is good enough to win with even luck and her A-game. ADELAIDE RED (6) has ground to make up on ALDEBARAN ADA through their Oaks clash but she had a second line barrier there. Draws inside that rivals this time and she goes well here with a win and placing from two attempts. AMIRA (2) has come from wider barriers in her last two appearance in Group 1 races but came from the inside to win a Need For Speed Princess heat three back so is much better served by this barrier. JILLIBY RADIANCE (5) jumps in grade but did a good job to overcome a back row draw and win here last week.
